title: Pre-solicitation notice for Dental Staffing Services
agency_path: HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES, DEPARTMENT OF.INDIAN HEALTH SERVICE.GREAT PLAINS AREA INDIAN HEALTH SVC
detail_text: The Great Plains Area Indian Health Service intends to issue a solicitation for non-personal healthcare service, commercial item, single award, labor hour purchase order with fixed, fully loaded (all-inclusive) hourly rates for Dental Department Staffing Services at the Woodrow Wilson Keeble Memorial Health Care Center, Sisseton, South Dakota. The anticipated solicitation date is March 16, 2026 The PSC is Q503: Medical - Dentistry The NAICS is 621210: Offices of Dentists which has a small business size standard of $9 million. The proposed solicitation number is 75H70626Q00042 with an anticipated closing date of March 16, 2025. This solicitation will be issued as a 100% Indian Small Business Economic Enterprise (ISBEE) Set-Aside.
